Medial meniscus: Complex tear of the posterior horn/body with a small flap formation migrating into the lateral meniscotibial gutter. Minimal peripheral extrusion of the body segment. Root attachments are intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Fraying of the body segment inner margin.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Patellar cartilage is maintained. Focal full-thickness fissuring along the medial/central trochlea with underlying subchondral cystic change.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Chronic partial tear of the proximal fibers.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Intact, with periligamentous edema likely related to medial meniscal pathology.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

2.	Inner margin fraying of the lateral meniscal body.

5.	Small knee effusion with synovitis.
